title: ICSI Announces CS Professional & Executive June 2026 Result Date & December 2026 Exam Schedule
content:
# ICSI Announces CS Professional & Executive June 2026 Result Date & December 2026 Exam Schedule

Ek important update hai Company Secretary (CS) students ke liye! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne June 2026 session ke Professional aur Executive Programme ke results ki declaration date aur December 2026 term ke examinations ki dates announce kar di hain.

Here are the key details:

*   **CS Professional & Executive June 2026 Results:**
    *   Results will be declared on **Tuesday, August 25, 2026**.
    *   CS Professional Programme ka result subah **11:00 AM** par announce hoga.
    *   CS Executive Programme ka result afternoon **2:00 PM** par declare hoga.
    *   Results ICSI ki official website, `www.icsi.edu`, par available honge.
*   **CS Professional & Executive December 2026 Exam Dates:**
    *   December 2026 term ke examinations **Monday, December 21, 2026, se Monday, December 28, 2026,** tak conduct kiye jaayenge.
    *   Examinations afternoon session mein honge, typically 2:00 PM to 5:15 PM, including 15 minutes ka reading time.
    *   **December 25, 2026**, ko koi exam schedule nahi kiya gaya hai.
*   **Online Enrolment for December 2026 Exams:**
    *   December 2026 session ke liye online enrolment applications **Wednesday, August 26, 2026,** se commence honge.

Students ko salaah di jaati hai ki woh latest updates ke liye ICSI ki official website regularly visit karte rahein.
